files.content:
// shadcn
import {
  InputOTP,
  InputOTPGroup,
  InputOTPSeparator,
  InputOTPSlot,
} from "@/components/ui/input-otp"

//  ------------------------------ | INPUT OTP - SEPARATOR | ------------------------------  //

export default function InputOTPWithSeparator() {
  return (
    <InputOTP maxLength={6}>
      <InputOTPGroup>
        <InputOTPSlot index={0} />
        <InputOTPSlot index={1} />
      </InputOTPGroup>
      <InputOTPSeparator />
      <InputOTPGroup>
        <InputOTPSlot index={2} />
        <InputOTPSlot index={3} />
      </InputOTPGroup>
      <InputOTPSeparator />
      <InputOTPGroup>
        <InputOTPSlot index={4} />
        <InputOTPSlot index={5} />
      </InputOTPGroup>
    </InputOTP>
  )
}
